description: MCP server for Proofpoint Essentials -- MSP org, domain, user, licensing, and reporting management.
name: io.github.WYRE-AI/proofpoint-essentials-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Proofpoint Essentials org-administrator username (used for the X-User header)
environmentVariables.name: PROOFPOINT_ESSENTIALS_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: Proofpoint Essentials org-administrator password (used for the X-Password header)
environmentVariables.name: PROOFPOINT_ESSENTIALS_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Region subdomain, e.g. 'us1' or 'eu1'. Defaults to 'us1'.
environmentVariables.name: PROOFPOINT_ESSENTIALS_REGION

environmentVariables.description: Transport mode. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.
environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL

title: Proofpoint Essentials
